points.description: States that the experimental approach is to implement (code/run) the algorithm and measure its actual (physical) running time, e.g. with a clock/timer.
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks if only one half is given: either implementing/running the algorithm, or measuring time, without linking the two.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying, in any wording, that you implement or run the algorithm and measure how long it actually takes. Part marks for a vague or half answer, such as only 'run it' or 'use a timer', or a related idea like testing on different inputs without saying to measure time. No marks for answers about theoretical analysis, counting operations or Big-O only.
